summary: A candidate loses endorsements one by one after criticism, and then leaves the race with the name still on the ballot.
realLife: A school board candidate lost the support of sitting board members over alleged ties he denied, announced a withdrawal, and had his name remain on the ballot because it was already printed.
sources: OPB, school board candidate withdraws again, May 10, 2023: https://www.opb.org/article/2023/05/10/portland-school-board-candidate-derrick-peterson-withdraws-from-the-race-again
inGame: needs: an endorsement that can be withdrawn and a ballot-printing date after which a withdrawal leaves the name

turns.writesBack: the endorsement list stays and the race goes on

turns.turn: The endorsers pull back and the candidate exits
